pull-request-header:
*ੈ✩‧₊˚ **release** ‧₊˚✩ੈ*

Version bump + changelog, derived from the conventional commits on `main`. Nothing here is final: **edit `CHANGELOG.md` in this PR** to turn the generated one-liners into the prose this changelog is written in, then merge.

CI is skipped on purpose — every commit listed below already passed the full pipeline on `main`, and this PR only touches `package.json` and `CHANGELOG.md`.

Merging tags `v${version}`, publishes the GitHub Release, and cuts the matching Sentry release.
pull-request-footer:
---

The changelog is regenerated whenever a new commit lands on `main`, which discards manual edits — so curate late and merge promptly. `### Removed` has no commit type behind it; add it by hand when a release drops something.
